about: Inputs that once failed the whole write or read wrongly: a multi-line XML tag, an element value on its own line, an empty manifest, an empty __main__.py, an empty package name, a groupId collision, a reference in another case, a peer range, JVM properties, Vite built-ins, Prisma env(), an Express router mounted from another file, a compose override, a fetch whose method was read from the next call's options.
nearMisses: org.thirdparty:api is not the local com.my:api, so no cycle
an empty requirements.txt declares no module
an empty __main__.py is an entry point with no line to cite
peerDependencies >=17 beside devDependencies ^18 is not drift
ms in dependencies and devDependencies of ONE manifest is not drift
fetch(/api/users) falls under a router mounted at /api/users elsewhere
fetch('/api/products') takes no method from the POST of fetch('/api/checkout') on a later line; a method on a later line of the same call is still read
a FastAPI backend is runnable, not an orphan
web in docker-compose.override.yml is the same service
tests/fixtures/sample (outside any module) and srv/tests/fixtures/sample (inside one) are sample projects: no module, and its undeclared import is not this project's
